parts.text: Which claim correctly classifies the sponge and the tile?

options.text: The sponge is soft; the ceramic tile is hard.
The sponge is hard; the ceramic tile is soft.
You cannot tell hard or soft from pressing or scratching.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kavya presses a kitchen sponge and a ceramic floor tile, then gently scratches each. Soft materials change shape or scratch easily; hard materials resist both.

part_answers.answer: The sponge compresses and scratches easily, so it is soft; the ceramic tile resists compression and scratching, so it is hard.

teacher.key_rationale: Soft materials change shape or scratch easily; hard materials resist. Swapping soft/hard reverses the relationship; press and scratch tests do classify hardness.
